newsitem.title: USA: IVI to complete debt financing in Nov.
newsitem.headline: IVI to complete debt financing in Nov.

text.p: IVI Publishing Inc said on Wednesday it expects to complete a $3 million convertible debt financing this month.

Chairman Tim Maudlin said, "With the expected completion of this financing, coupled with the exciting online and operational progress taking place at IVI, we are very optimistic about the company's potential both in the near term as well as on a long term basis."

IVI Publishing, an electronic publisher of interactive multimedia health and medical information, reported a third-quarter loss of $0.51 per share compared with a year-ago loss of $0.74 per share. The 1996 third-quarter results included a $1.3 million writedown from downsizing actions and a $836,000 charge from bad debt.
